candidates.name: Features and Geometries JSON (JSON-FG)
verified_facts: JSON-FG extends GeoJSON to support additional geospatial requirements while remaining valid GeoJSON.
The standard addresses feature and geometry representation, including capabilities beyond baseline GeoJSON restrictions.
semantic_limits: A richer feature/geometry encoding does not certify coordinate accuracy, parcel legal extent or vertical terrain measurement quality.

candidates.name: KML
verified_facts: KML is an XML language focused on geographic visualization and annotation of maps and images.
It encodes what to display in an earth browser and how to display it.
semantic_limits: Visualization coordinates and annotations are not a survey certificate and do not establish parcel ground elevation or vertical accuracy.
